parameters.query: WITH written AS (INSERT INTO notification_event (run_id,user_id,product_id,channel,mode,status,idempotency_key) SELECT e.run_id,e.user_id,e.product_id,'email','preview','previewed',e.run_id::text||':'||e.user_id||':'||e.product_id||':preview' FROM eligibility_result e WHERE e.run_id=$1::uuid AND e.decision='eligible' ON CONFLICT (idempotency_key) DO NOTHING RETURNING event_id) SELECT $1::text AS run_id,COUNT(n.event_id) AS eligible_matches,COUNT(DISTINCT lower(u.email)) AS distinct_email_addresses,COUNT(DISTINCT (u.run_id,u.user_id)) AS distinct_applicants,COUNT(DISTINCT w.event_id) AS new_preview_events,'preview'::text AS mode,FALSE AS delivery_enabled FROM notification_event n JOIN batch_user u ON u.run_id=n.run_id AND u.user_id=n.user_id LEFT JOIN written w ON TRUE WHERE n.run_id=$1::uuid AND n.mode='preview' AND n.status='previewed'
